enabled.description: Master switch for the covert/side-channel egress reference monitor.

posture.description: default: lossless stages enforce, the rest audit. enforce: every stage enforces.

stages.description: Per-stage mode overrides keyed by stage id.

capacityBits.description: Bucket size per destination: the largest burst of estimated covert bits allowed (default 4096).

refillBitsPerSec.description: Steady refill rate per destination (default 256). 0 means no refill: a fixed budget for the life of the process.

ledger.description: Per-destination capacity ledger (token bucket of estimated covert bits).

toolCall.description: Mediate outbound tool arguments. Defaults to on in the hardened posture, off otherwise.

modelInput.description: Mediate tool results and inbound channel messages before they enter the model context. Defaults to on in the hardened posture, off otherwise.

llm.description: Model used by the egress-llm-scrambler stage.

coverTraffic.description: Back the egress-cover-traffic service with the channel send path.

media.description: Mediate outbound attachments through the media scramblers and canonical media order (media_sending). Default on; inert until a media scrambler plugin is enabled or stages["egress-media-order"] is enforce.
